stages.name: Dev baseline
stages.review: Reachable dev health API and real CLI integration; target/retention evidence
stages.execution: operator task represented by a human evaluation; no developer dispatch

stages.name: Product and repository foundation
stages.review: Deployed Product/identity API evidence, denied-input logs and legacy compatibility
stages.execution: reviewed code, repository evaluation, supported operations assistance, then human evidence review

stages.name: GitHub-to-delivery journey
stages.review: Native GitHub hierarchy, Product-bound A/B delivery, dev API/CLI version result and UI walkthrough
stages.execution: reviewed code, repository evaluation, supported operations assistance, then human evidence review

stages.name: Evidence and corrections
stages.review: Passing and refused exact-revision verdicts, correctly routed repair and deployed retest
stages.execution: reviewed code, repository evaluation, supported operations assistance, then human evidence review

stages.name: Full qualification and compatibility
stages.review: Full fault/recovery matrix, UI/CLI/API evidence, legacy compatibility and cleanup
stages.execution: reviewed code, repository evaluation, MR-14 manual qualification launch, then final human acceptance
stages.integration_join: MR-14 waits for both reviewed merges and stage code evaluation. Run the complete offline matrix on the combined candidate before final live qualification.

bootstrap: Existing single-repository engine runs the aws-e/adp implementation flow. Product-bound fixture flows are created only after compatible code is deployed.
operations_binding_status: Actual environment connection, release/controller receipt, operator and reviewer must be bound before activation. Stage 0 is an operator task, not an agent executor.

fixtures.retention: Pre-existing reusable inputs; do not delete during a consuming run.
